args.title: checkout-api: v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west) began failing health checks, with error rate at 18% and healthy=false.

Action taken: Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release with a healthy status in production (release history: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy).

The first rollback attempt failed partway (halted after us-east with an orchestrator error), leaving a mixed state (us-east=v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west=v2.3.1). A retry completed successfully across all three regions.

Current status: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate ~0.2%.

Open item: the v2.3.1-rc staging build was also unhealthy, suggesting the defect was detectable pre-production. Recommend investigating the v2.3.1 change set and the release gate before any re-deploy of v2.3.1 (a deploy of v2.3.1 would require change-manager approval, as it has never been healthy in production).

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was created successfully despite the timeout (INC-0001) — no retry needed.

## Summary

**Rollback complete.** checkout-api is back to healthy in all production regions.

**What I found:**
- Current version v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), error rate 18%
- Release history: v2.2.9 (healthy) → v2.3.0 (healthy) → v2.3.1 (unhealthy); v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy
- So **v2.3.0** was the most recent release healthy in production

**What I did:**
1. Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt errored partway, halting after us-east and leaving a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west still on v2.3.1). I verified the state, retried, and the rollback then completed across all three regions.
2. Verified the result: all regions on v2.3.0, `healthy=true`, error rate down to 0.2%.
3. Opened **INC-0001**, SEV2, on checkout-api, documenting the failure, the partial-failure/retry, the final state, and the follow-up.

**Worth flagging:**
- The `create_incident` call timed out at 30s, but the incident had in fact been created — I checked `list_incidents` before retrying and did not duplicate the page.
- **v2.3.1-rc was already unhealthy in staging**, so this defect was visible before it reached production. I'd look at the release gate. Also note that any future deploy of v2.3.1 will require change-manager approval, since it has never been healthy in production.

transcript.reasoning_content:
Now open SEV2 incident. Use idempotency key.
